ps.en: When a [[sophisticated]] stranger arrived at the city gate, the old [[shelter]] by the river had long been home to people with nothing left to [[share]]. The [[sovereign]] of the region, known for a [[sharp]] wit and a sharper sword, watched the newcomer with quiet interest.
ps.zh: 当一位老练的陌生人来到城门时，河边的旧庇护所早已成了那些再无物可分享之人的归宿。这一地区的君主以机敏的才智和更锋利的剑闻名，正静静打量着这位来客。

ps.en: The stranger began to [[perform]] each evening, and his [[performance]] soon became the only [[topic]] anyone cared to discuss. What he did was [[sow]] small doubts about the high [[toll]] the road demanded, and the [[tone]] of the marketplace shifted from fear to curiosity.
ps.zh: 陌生人每晚开始表演，而他的演出很快成了人们唯一关心的话题。他所做的，是在那条路索要的高昂代价上播下小小的疑问，市场的气氛也随之从恐惧转向好奇。

ps.en: Over a long [[period]], the town's old orders began to [[perish]], yet a [[perpetual]] question would not leave them: why did fortune favour the few? The stranger's riddles [[perplex]] the council for months, until a visiting [[periodical]] printed the answer and the people finally understood.
ps.zh: 在很长一段时期里，小镇的旧秩序开始消亡，但一个永恒的问题始终萦绕不去：为何好运只眷顾少数人？陌生人的谜语让议会困惑了数月，直到一份来访的期刊把答案印了出来，人们才终于明白。

ps.en: From the [[perspective]] of the small research [[organization]], the soil was either a gift or a grave. Some scientists were [[pessimistic]] about the harvest; others, more [[optimistic]], believed the [[optimum]] conditions were still within reach.
ps.zh: 从这家小型研究机构的视角看，土地要么是恩赐，要么是坟墓。一些科学家对收成感到悲观；另一些更为乐观的人则相信，最适宜的条件仍有可能达到。

ps.en: The [[option]] to use chemical feed was [[optional]], so the team chose to [[organize]] a natural trial instead. They hoped to [[enhance]] the soil with [[organism|organism]]s and to [[enlarge]] the plot where [[organic]] crops could grow free of synthetic aid.
ps.zh: 使用化学肥料这一选项是可任选的，于是团队转而组织了一场自然试验。他们希望用微生物来增强土壤，并扩大那片能让有机作物在无合成助剂下生长的田地。

ps.en: The work did more than feed them; it began to [[enlighten]] a weary public, and the old man would [[rake]] through the leaves to show how [[rare]] life could be when left alone. What started as a single seed had become a quiet argument for another way of living.
ps.zh: 这项工作不只是喂饱了他们；它开始启发疲惫的公众，而老人会耙开落叶，展示当任其自生自灭时，生命可以多么珍稀。始于一颗种子的事，最终成了一场关于另一种生活方式的静默辩论。

ps.en: Most visitors [[rarely]] stopped to think about the [[rate]] at which the old bridge was fading, or the strange [[ratio]] of stone to silence it held. A [[rational]] mind, however, could [[reach]] the same conclusion before the first crack appeared.
ps.zh: 多数访客很少停下来思考这座老桥消逝的速度，或它那石与静默之间奇特的比例。然而，一个理性的头脑能在第一道裂缝出现前就得出同样的结论。

ps.en: When the water rose, people began to [[react]] in ways that were not always [[realistic]]. Maya was the first to [[realize]] a hard [[reality]]: the path they had chosen was no longer safe, and someone had to [[select]] a new one.
ps.zh: 当水涨起来时，人们开始以并不总是现实的方式反应。玛雅第一个意识到一个残酷的现实：他们选的那条路已不再安全，必须有人另选一条。

ps.en: From the [[selection]] on offer she made a [[sensible]] call, trusting her own [[sense]] more than the crowd's panic. The decision caused a small [[sensation]], yet it proved how a [[sensitive]] leader can steady a frightened room.
ps.zh: 在提供的选项中，她作出了明智的选择，比起人群的恐慌更相信自己的判断力。这个决定引起了一阵小小的轰动，却也证明了敏感的领导者如何让一间惊恐的屋子安定下来。

ps.en: The village kept its troubles [[separate]] for years, but a single [[sequence]] of bad harvests changed everything. In a [[series]] of meetings, what had seemed a small dispute grew into something [[serious]].
ps.zh: 村庄把麻烦分开了好多年，但一连串歉收改变了一切。在一系列会议上，看似微小的争端演变成严肃的大事。

ps.en: They raised a [[token]] of peace and, for once, chose to [[tolerate]] rather than punish. In a [[serial]] account published weeks later, the elders proved more [[tolerant]] than expected, showing a quiet [[tolerance]] that surprised the young.
ps.zh: 他们举起一枚和平的信物，并且破天荒选择容忍而非惩罚。在数周后发表的一篇连载记述里，向来严厉的长老们展现出出人意料的宽容，那份静默的包容让年轻人感到意外。

ps.en: Debts began to [[accumulate]], and the records lost their [[accuracy]] as panic spread. Still, the community found cause to [[toast]] its survival, working [[together]] with a more [[accurate]] count of what it owned. No one moved to [[accuse]] the careless farmer, and in time they [[achieve]] a balance the law alone could not.
ps.zh: 债务开始累积，随着恐慌蔓延，记录也失去了准确性。但社区仍为幸存干杯，以一份更精确的自身家底清点共同度过难关。没人去指控那个粗心的农夫，久而久之，他们达成了法律单独无法实现的平衡。

ps.en: The company's [[board]] liked to [[boast]] about every small [[bonus]], but this year the market had given them a real [[boom]]. To [[boost]] morale, the director chose to [[cherish]] the quiet workers no one else noticed, and to [[acknowledge]] effort over outcome.
ps.zh: 公司的董事会喜欢吹嘘每一笔小小的奖金，但今年市场给了他们一场真正的繁荣。为了提振士气，总监选择珍视那些无人留意的安静员工，并肯定过程而非结果。

ps.en: A [[chemical]] spill had once threatened the firm, and a tiny [[chip]] in the main [[vessel]] had nearly sunk it. Yet the team's [[choice]] to [[choose]] transparency proved wise; they could [[verify]] every claim and let the [[verdict]] of customers decide.
ps.zh: 一次化学品泄漏曾威胁过这家公司，主容器上的一道小裂痕也几乎让它沉没。然而团队选择透明的做法被证明是明智的；他们能核实每一项声明，并把裁决交给顾客。

ps.en: Investors began to [[cheer]], and a witty [[verbal]] jab in the meeting became a [[verse]] people quoted for weeks. The final [[version]] of the plan, released as an official [[organ]] of the group, showed how a calm room can outlast any storm.
ps.zh: 投资者开始欢呼，会上的一句机智口头嘲讽成了人们数周来反复引用的诗句。计划的最终版本作为集团的一份官方机构发布，显示出一间冷静的屋子如何比任何风暴都持久。

words.exam: 一份；份额；股份；分享；分担；分配
c: share sth with sb 与…分享
a share of the market 市场份额
share the burden 分担重担
fam: share n. 股份 / v. 分享
words.dif: share 作名词指「份额、股份」，作动词指「分享、分担」，考试常考动词义
words.pat: The two villages decided to share the cost of the new bridge.
words.patZh: 两个村庄决定共同分担那座新桥的费用。

words.exam: 锋利的；轮廓分明的；急转的；敏锐的
c: a sharp knife 锋利的刀
a sharp turn 急转弯
a sharp mind 敏锐的头脑
words.dif: sharp 既可形容「物理锋利」也可形容「反应/思维敏锐」，adv. 表「准时地」(at seven sharp)
words.pat: A sharp rise in prices forced many families to change their habits.
words.patZh: 价格的急剧上涨迫使许多家庭改变习惯。

words.exam: 掩蔽处；躲避处；掩蔽；保护
c: take shelter from the rain 避雨
a shelter for the homeless 收容所
shelter sb from danger 保护…免受危险
words.dif: shelter 名动同形：名词「庇护所」，动词「庇护、躲避」，常接 from
words.pat: The old cave gave shelter to travellers during the storm.
words.patZh: 那座旧洞穴在风暴中为旅人提供了庇护。

words.exam: 复杂的；精密的；尖端的；老练的
c: a sophisticated machine 精密的机器
a sophisticated audience 老练的观众
sophisticated technology 尖端技术
words.dif: sophisticated 常考「复杂的/精密的」与「老练的（人）」两层，别只记高深
words.pat: Modern consumers expect sophisticated and reliable products.
words.patZh: 现代消费者期待精密且可靠的产品。

words.exam: 君主；元首；至高无上的；独立自主的
c: a sovereign state 主权国家
the sovereign 君主
sovereign power 至高无上的权力
words.dif: sovereign 作名词是「君主」，作形容词是「至高无上的、独立自主的」（a sovereign state 主权国家）；注意拼写中 -erei- 不发音
words.pat: A sovereign has supreme authority within the borders of the state.
words.patZh: 君主在国境之内拥有至高无上的权威。

c: sow seeds 播种
sow doubt 播下怀疑
sow the seeds of conflict 埋下冲突的种子
fam: sowed / sown（过去分词） n. 相关延伸
words.dif: sow 本义「播种」，引申「传播（疑虑、谣言）」，与 seed 常搭配
words.pat: Rumours sown in haste can destroy trust for years.
words.patZh: 匆忙播下的谣言能毁掉多年的信任。

c: take a heavy toll 造成严重损失
a toll road 收费公路
the death toll 死亡人数
fam: take its toll 造成恶果 n. 相关延伸
words.dif: toll 最易考「代价、损失」（take a toll on），也指「通行费、钟声」
words.pat: The pandemic took a heavy toll on small businesses.
words.patZh: 这场大流行给小企业造成了沉重代价。

c: the tone of the meeting 会议的气氛
a friendly tone 友好的语气
set the tone 定下基调
words.dif: tone 既指「声音/语气」也指「整体气氛、基调」，写作里 set the tone 很常用
words.pat: His speech set a hopeful tone for the whole campaign.
words.patZh: 他的演讲为整场运动定下了充满希望的基调。

c: a hot topic 热门话题
on the topic of 关于…话题
change the topic 换话题
fam: topical adj. 热门的；时事的
words.dif: topic 是「谈论的话题」，theme 是「贯穿的中心思想」，常并列设题
words.pat: Climate change remains the top topic at the conference.
words.patZh: 气候变化仍是会上最热门的话题。

c: perform a task 执行任务
perform on stage 登台表演
perform well 表现出色
words.dif: perform 兼「表演」与「执行/表现」，后者在职场语境常考
words.pat: Companies must perform their promises to win trust.
words.patZh: 公司必须履行承诺才能赢得信任。

words.exam: 执行；表演；演出；表现；业绩
c: a live performance 现场演出
job performance 工作表现
economic performance 经济业绩
words.dif: performance 可指「演出」也可指「表现/业绩」，词义随语境切换
words.pat: The team's performance improved after the new coach arrived.
words.patZh: 新教练到来后，球队的表现有所提升。

words.exam: 周期；一段时期；时代；课时；句点
c: over a long period 在很长一段时期内
a period of peace 和平时期
the Roman period 罗马时代
words.dif: period 最基础义是「一段时间/时期」，也指「课时、句号」，作周期义时接 periodic
words.pat: Over a long period, small habits shape who we become.
words.patZh: 在很长一段时期里，细微的习惯塑造了我们成为谁。

c: a learned periodical 学术期刊
a periodical publication 定期出版物
periodical changes 周期性变化
words.dif: periodical 作名词指「期刊/杂志」，作形容词指「周期的、定期的」
words.pat: The study appeared in a leading scientific periodical.
words.patZh: 该研究发表在一份顶尖科学期刊上。

words.exam: 死亡；毁灭；消亡；腐败；老化
c: perish in the fire 葬身火海
perishable goods 易腐货物
old ideas perish 旧观念消亡
words.dif: perish 书面语，指「消亡、毁灭」，也用于「（食物）腐败」(perishable)
words.pat: Without care, even the strongest traditions can perish.
words.patZh: 不加呵护，再坚固的传统也可能消亡。

words.exam: 永恒的；反复的；没完没了的
c: perpetual snow 终年积雪
a perpetual noise 没完没了的噪音
perpetual motion 永动
words.dif: perpetual 强调「持续不断、反复」，可褒（永恒）可贬（没完没了）
words.pat: The perpetual debate over fairness never quite ends.
words.patZh: 关于公平的反复争辩从未真正平息。

c: perplex the reader 使读者困惑
a perplexing question 令人困惑的问题
be perplexed by 对…感到困惑
words.dif: perplex 是及物「使困惑」，常与 puzzle/confuse 同框；注意它是动词
words.pat: The sudden change in policy perplexed many investors.
words.patZh: 政策的骤变让许多投资者感到困惑。

words.exam: 观点；看法；判断力；洞察力；透视画法
c: from one's perspective 从某人的视角
gain perspective 获得洞察
a new perspective 新视角
words.dif: perspective 常考「观点/视角」与「洞察力、判断力」，from one's perspective 是写作好句
words.pat: From the perspective of history, the crisis was only a moment.
words.patZh: 从历史的角度看，那场危机不过是一瞬。

c: a pessimistic view 悲观的看法
be pessimistic about 对…悲观
pessimistic forecast 悲观预测
fam: optimistic 反义 n. 相关延伸
words.dif: pessimistic 与 optimistic 是一对反义形容词，考试常成对出现
words.pat: Young people need not be pessimistic about the future.
words.patZh: 年轻人不必对未来悲观。

c: an optimistic attitude 乐观的态度
be optimistic about 对…乐观
cautiously optimistic 谨慎乐观
fam: pessimistic 反义 n. 相关延伸
words.dif: optimistic 常与 about 搭配；optimistic / pessimistic 是阅读高频反义词对
words.pat: Experts are optimistic that the economy will recover.
words.patZh: 专家对经济复苏持乐观态度。

c: optimum conditions 最适宜的条件
the optimum temperature 最佳温度
optimum size 最佳规模
words.dif: optimum 是「最适宜的、最优的」，近义 optimal；常修饰 conditions/temperature
words.pat: Plants grow best under optimum light and moisture.
words.patZh: 植物在最佳光照与湿度下长得最好。

words.exam: 选择；选择权；可选项；买卖选择权；选修课
c: have no option but to 别无选择只能
keep one's options open 保留选择余地
a free option 自由选择权
words.dif: option 可指「选择权」也可指「可选项/选修课」，have no option but to 是写作句型
words.pat: We had no option but to postpone the meeting.
words.patZh: 我们别无选择，只能推迟会议。

words.exam: 可任选的；非强制的；选修的
c: optional subjects 选修课
optional extras 可选附加项
attendance is optional 出席自愿
words.dif: optional 表示「可任选的、非强制的」，与 compulsory（强制的）反义
words.pat: The training is optional but strongly recommended.
words.patZh: 该培训非强制，但强烈建议参加。

c: a government organ 政府机关
internal organs 内脏器官
a pipe organ 管风琴
fam: organic adj. 器官的；有机的
words.dif: organ 一词多义：①机构/机关 ②（人体）器官 ③风琴；与 organic 同源
words.pat: The court is an organ of the state responsible for justice.
words.patZh: 法院是国家负责司法的机关。

words.exam: 器官的；有机物的；有机的；演进的
c: organic food 有机食品
organic compounds 有机化合物
organic growth 自然增长
words.dif: organic 常考「有机的」（organic food/growth），也表「器官的、器质性的」；与 organ（器官；机构）同源但词性不同
words.pat: Consumers increasingly prefer organic produce over processed food.
words.patZh: 消费者越来越偏爱有机农产品而非加工食品。

c: a living organism 活的有机体
a tiny organism 微生物
a social organism 社会有机体
words.dif: organism 指「生物/有机体」，可大可小（微生物亦可），区别于 organ（器官）
words.pat: Every organism depends on its surroundings to survive.
words.patZh: 每一个有机体都依赖周遭环境生存。

c: a international organization 国际组织
the organization of work 工作的组织
without organization 缺乏条理
words.dif: organization 兼「机构/团体」与「组织性、条理性」，写作可指「有条理」
words.pat: Good organization saves more time than hard work alone.
words.patZh: 良好的条理性比单纯苦干更省时间。

c: organize a meeting 筹备会议
organize one's thoughts 整理思路
organize a strike 组织罢工
words.dif: organize 既指「组织活动」也指「整理、使有条理」，常接 thoughts/events
words.pat: We need to organize the data before drawing any conclusion.
words.patZh: 在下结论前，我们需要先把数据整理好。

c: enhance one's reputation 提升声誉
enhance performance 增强表现
enhance the image 改善形象
words.dif: enhance 是及物「提高、增强」，与 improve 近义但更正式，常接 reputation/quality
words.pat: Reading widely can enhance both vocabulary and judgment.
words.patZh: 广泛阅读能同时提升词汇量与判断力。

c: enlarge a photo 放大照片
enlarge one's horizons 开阔眼界
enlarge the house 扩建房屋
words.dif: enlarge 强调「使尺寸/范围变大」，图片放大、眼界开阔都可用
words.pat: Travel helps enlarge a person's view of the world.
words.patZh: 旅行有助于开阔一个人对世界的看法。

c: enlighten the public 启发公众
an enlightening book 启发性读物
be enlightened on 在…上受启发
words.dif: enlighten 书面语「启发、使醒悟」，enlightening 常形容「有启发性的」
words.pat: A good teacher enlightens rather than merely instructs.
words.patZh: 好的老师启发人，而不只是灌输。

words.exam: 耙；梳理；大量搜索；赚大钱
c: rake the leaves 耙落叶
rake through files 翻检档案
rake in money 赚大钱
words.dif: rake 名词「耙」，动词「耙、翻检、搜寻」；俚语 rake in 表「赚大钱」
words.pat: Reporters raked through the records for the truth.
words.patZh: 记者翻检档案以寻找真相。

c: a rare disease 罕见病
rare air 稀薄的空气
a rare opportunity 难得的机会
words.dif: rare 指「稀少、珍贵」，也指空气「稀薄」；rarely 是其副词
words.pat: Such honesty is rare in the competitive world of business.
words.patZh: 在竞争激烈的商业世界里，这样的诚实很难得。

c: rarely seen 很少见到
rarely if ever 几乎从不
rarely enough 少得可怜
words.dif: rarely 是频度副词，放句首时句子要倒装（Rarely did he...）
words.pat: People rarely appreciate what they have until it is gone.
words.patZh: 人们很少在拥有时珍惜，直到失去才后悔。

words.exam: 比率；速度；费率；价格；评估；定级
c: the birth rate 出生率
at a fast rate 以飞快速度
rate sb highly 高度评价某人
words.dif: rate 名词「比率/速度/费率」，动词「评估、定级」，常考 birth/unemployment rate
words.pat: The local unemployment rate has fallen for three years.
words.patZh: 当地失业率已连续三年下降。

c: the ratio of A to B A 与 B 之比
a high ratio 高比例
in ratio 成比例
fam: rational adj. 理性的（同词根 ratio）
words.dif: ratio 强调「两者之比」（A to B），proportion 强调「部分占整体的比例」
words.pat: The ratio of teachers to students affects learning quality.
words.patZh: 师生之比会影响学习质量。

c: a rational decision 理性的决定
rational behaviour 合理行为
perfectly rational 完全合理
fam: irrational 反义 n. 相关延伸
words.dif: rational 指「理性的、基于逻辑的」，反义 irrational；与 reasonable 近义
words.pat: A rational person weighs evidence before acting.
words.patZh: 理性的人在行动前会权衡证据。

words.exam: 到达；够到；能达到的范围；影响范围
c: reach the top 到达顶点
within reach 够得着
reach a conclusion 得出结论
fam: beyond reach 够不着 n. 相关延伸
words.dif: reach 动词「到达/够到」，名词「可及范围」；reach a decision/conclusion 是搭配
words.pat: The goal is within reach if we keep working.
words.patZh: 只要我们坚持，目标就触手可及。

c: react to the news 对消息作出反应
react against 反抗
react with 与…起反应
words.dif: react 是不及物，必须接 to（react to），别漏介词
words.pat: Markets react quickly to changes in interest rates.
words.patZh: 市场对利率变化反应迅速。

words.exam: 现实的；明智的；能实现的
c: a realistic goal 现实的目标
be realistic about 对…现实
realistic expectations 务实的期待
words.dif: realistic 指「现实的、可实现的」，反义 unrealistic；区别于 real（真实的）
words.pat: Set realistic targets so progress stays possible.
words.patZh: 设定现实的目标，进展才有可能。

c: face reality 面对现实
in reality 实际上
the harsh reality 残酷的现实
words.dif: reality 是「现实、真实情况」，in reality / face reality 是高频搭配
words.pat: In reality, the plan was far harder than it looked.
words.patZh: 实际上，这计划比看上去难得多。

c: realize one's dream 实现梦想
realize the danger 意识到危险
realize how... 意识到多么…
words.dif: realize 两层：①意识到（=realize that）②实现（=achieve）；后者与 dream/goal 搭配
words.pat: She realized her mistake only after the meeting.
words.patZh: 她直到会后才意识到自己的错误。

words.exam: 选择；挑选；精选的；优等的
c: select a candidate 挑选候选人
a select group 精英小组
select few 少数佼佼者
words.dif: select 作动词「挑选」，作形容词「精选的、优等的」；区别于 elected（当选的）
words.pat: Schools select students on both merit and potential.
words.patZh: 学校既看成绩也看潜力来选拔学生。

words.exam: 选择；挑选；精选物；入选者
c: a wide selection 丰富选择
make a selection 作出选择
natural selection 自然选择
words.dif: selection 是 select 的名词，可指「选择行为」或「精选出来的人/物」
words.pat: The final selection will be announced next week.
words.patZh: 最终入选名单将于下周公布。

words.exam: 感觉；感官；判断力；意义；觉察
c: common sense 常识
make sense 讲得通
sense danger 感觉到危险
words.dif: sense 多义：感官/感觉、判断力、意义；make sense 与 a sense of 极常考
words.pat: She had the good sense to leave early.
words.patZh: 她有早早离开的明智判断力。

words.exam: 感觉；知觉；轰动；轰动一时的事
c: a burning sensation 灼烧感
cause a sensation 引起轰动
a sensation among readers 读者中的轰动
fam: sensational adj. 轰动的；耸人听闻的
words.dif: sensation 既指「身体感觉/知觉」也指「轰动（一时的事）」，sensational 常贬义
words.pat: The novel caused a sensation when first published.
words.patZh: 这部小说初版时引起了轰动。

words.exam: 明智的；合情理的；明显的
c: a sensible plan 明智的计划
sensible shoes 实用的鞋
perfectly sensible 完全合理
fam: sensitive 形近（敏感的） n. 相关延伸
words.dif: sensible「明智、合情理的」；sensitive「敏感的」形近易混，注意区分
words.pat: It is sensible to save before you spend.
words.patZh: 先储蓄后消费是明智的。

c: be sensitive to 对…敏感
a sensitive issue 敏感话题
sensitive equipment 精密设备
fam: sensible 形近（明智的） n. 相关延伸
words.dif: sensitive「敏感的、灵敏的」，常接 to；与 sensible（明智的）仅差一个字母
words.pat: Children are sensitive to the moods of adults.
words.patZh: 儿童对成年人的情绪很敏感。

words.exam: 分开的；单独的；不同的；使分开
c: separate the facts from opinions 区分事实与观点
live separate 分开住
a separate room 单独的房间
words.dif: separate 作形容词读 ˈseprət，作动词读 ˈsepreɪt，拼写一致读音不同
words.pat: We should separate facts from personal feelings.
words.patZh: 我们应当把事实与私人情感分开。

c: in sequence 按顺序
a sequence of events 一连串事件
the correct sequence 正确次序
fam: consequence n. 后果（同根 sequ）
words.dif: sequence 指「次序」或「连续发生的事」，in sequence 表「按顺序」
words.pat: The sequence of steps must be followed exactly.
words.patZh: 必须严格按步骤顺序操作。

words.exam: 连续的；连载的；连续剧；定期刊物
c: a serial novel 连载小说
a serial publication 连续出版物
a TV serial 电视连续剧
words.dif: serial 强调「连续播出的、连载的」，series 是「系列、连续剧」名词
words.pat: The story first appeared as a serial in a magazine.
words.patZh: 这个故事最初以连载形式出现在一本杂志上。

c: a series of 一系列的
a TV series 电视连续剧
in series 串联
words.dif: series 单复数同形，常考 a series of（一系列）；serial 是形容词「连载的」，形近义不同
words.pat: The city suffered a series of storms that winter.
words.patZh: 那年冬天，这座城市遭遇了一系列风暴。

c: a serious problem 严重问题
be serious about 对…认真
a serious look 严肃的神情
fam: seriously adv. 严重地；认真地
words.dif: serious 兼「严重的」（a serious problem）与「认真的」（be serious about）；severe 语气更重，多修饰疾病、天气、惩罚
words.pat: We must take climate change seriously.
words.patZh: 我们必须严肃对待气候变化。

c: raise a toast 举杯祝酒
a toast to friendship 为友谊干杯
toast the bread 烤面包
words.dif: toast 既指「烤面包」也指「祝酒、干杯」，raise a toast to 是固定搭配
words.pat: They raised a toast to the village's survival.
words.patZh: 他们为村庄的幸存举杯。

c: work together 一起工作
put together 合起来
get together 聚会
words.dif: together 是副词「一起」，get together 表「聚会」，别与 altogether（完全）混淆
words.pat: The neighbours worked together through the crisis.
words.patZh: 邻居们一起熬过了危机。

words.exam: 标志；象征；纪念品；专用辅币；象征性的
c: a token of peace 和平的象征
by the same token 同理
a token gift 象征性礼物
words.dif: token 名词「象征、信物」，形容词「象征性的」（a token payment 象征性付款）
words.pat: The handshake was a token of their new friendship.
words.patZh: 那次握手是他们新友谊的象征。

c: tolerance of others 对他人的容忍
zero tolerance 零容忍
show tolerance 表现出宽容
fam: intolerance 反义 n. 相关延伸
words.dif: tolerance 是名词「容忍、耐性」，zero tolerance（零容忍）是新闻高频词
words.pat: A healthy society needs tolerance of different views.
words.patZh: 健康的社会需要对不同观点抱有容忍。

c: be tolerant of 对…宽容
a tolerant attitude 宽容的态度
more tolerant 更包容
fam: intolerant 反义 n. 相关延伸
words.dif: tolerant 是形容词「宽容的」，常接 of；注意与 tolerance（名词）词性区分
words.pat: Young people tend to be more tolerant of difference.
words.patZh: 年轻人往往对差异更宽容。

c: tolerate noise 容忍噪音
cannot tolerate 无法容忍
tolerate dissent 容忍异议
words.dif: tolerate 是及物「容忍」，比 bear/stand 正式；后接名词或动名词
words.pat: A democracy must tolerate opposing opinions.
words.patZh: 民主必须容忍对立的意见。

c: accumulate wealth 积累财富
accumulate evidence 累积证据
dust accumulates 灰尘堆积
words.dif: accumulate 指「逐渐积累、积聚」，强调由少到多的过程
words.pat: Small savings accumulate into a real fund over time.
words.patZh: 小额储蓄随时间积累成一笔实实在在的资金。

c: with accuracy 准确地
the accuracy of data 数据的准确性
improve accuracy 提高准确性
fam: inaccurate 反义 n. 相关延伸
words.dif: accuracy 是名词「准确性」，accurate 是形容词；写作常换用 precisely
words.pat: The accuracy of the report was later questioned.
words.patZh: 这份报告的准确性后来受到质疑。

c: an accurate description 准确的描述
accurate to the minute 精确到分钟
remain accurate 保持准确
words.dif: accurate 强调「与事实相符、准确」，accurate / exact / precise 近义需辨析
words.pat: Good decisions need accurate information.
words.patZh: 好的决策需要准确的信息。

c: accuse sb of theft 指控…盗窃
be accused of 被指控
false accuse 诬告
words.dif: accuse 固定搭配 accuse sb of (doing) sth；charge 也接 with，注意介词不同
words.pat: He was accused of hiding the truth from the public.
words.patZh: 他被指控向公众隐瞒真相。

c: achieve a goal 实现目标
achieve success 取得成功
achieve balance 达成平衡
words.dif: achieve 指「凭努力达成、实现」，常接 goal/success/balance；与 reach 近义
words.pat: Communities can achieve what laws alone cannot.
words.patZh: 社区能达成法律单独无法达成的事。

c: acknowledge one's mistake 承认错误
acknowledge help 对帮助表示感谢
widely acknowledged 被广泛承认
words.dif: acknowledge 两层：①承认（错误/事实）②致谢；比 admit 正式
words.pat: She acknowledged the team's effort more than its result.
words.patZh: 她肯定的是团队的努力而非结果。

c: cheer the winners 为获胜者欢呼
cheer up 振作起来
a loud cheer 响亮的欢呼声
words.dif: cheer 动词「欢呼、鼓舞」，cheer up 是「使振作」；名词指「欢呼声」
words.pat: The news made the whole room cheer.
words.patZh: 这消息让全屋的人欢呼起来。

c: chemical reaction 化学反应
chemical waste 化学废料
household chemicals 家用化学品
fam: chemist n. 化学家；药剂师
words.dif: chemical 兼形容词「化学的」与名词「化学制品」，chemist 还指「药剂师」
words.pat: The spill released harmful chemicals into the river.
words.patZh: 那次泄漏把有害化学品排入了河中。

c: cherish the memory 珍视回忆
cherish hope 怀抱希望
cherish freedom 珍爱自由
words.dif: cherish 书面语「珍爱、抱有（希望/想法）」，比 love 更正式
words.pat: We should cherish the quiet workers others overlook.
words.patZh: 我们应当珍视那些被他人忽视的安静员工。

words.exam: 打破；薄片；碎屑；集成电路块
c: a chip in the cup 杯子上的缺口
a silicon chip 硅芯片
potato chips 薯片
words.dif: chip 名词多义：碎片/缺口、薯片、芯片（microchip）；动词「削、打破」
words.pat: A tiny chip in the vessel nearly caused a leak.
words.patZh: 容器上一道小裂痕差点导致渗漏。

words.exam: 选择；挑选；选择项；精选的
c: make a choice 作出选择
a wide choice 丰富选择
choice apples 精选苹果
words.dif: choice 名词「选择、选择项」，形容词「精选的、优质的」；choose 是其动词
words.pat: The choice to be honest proved wise in the end.
words.patZh: 诚实这一选择最终被证明是明智的。

c: choose a path 选择道路
choose to do 愿意做
choose between 在…间选择
fam: chose / chosen（过去式/分词） n. 相关延伸
words.dif: choose 不规则动词 choose-chose-chosen；choose to do 表「情愿做」
words.pat: When firms choose transparency, public trust tends to grow.
words.patZh: 当企业选择透明，公众信任往往会增长。

words.exam: 木板；董事会；伙食；上船（车、飞机）
c: the board of directors 董事会
on board 在船上；上车
board a train 上火车
words.dif: board 多义：木板、董事会、伙食、上船/车；on board 是高频短语
words.pat: The board finally approved the new plan.
words.patZh: 董事会最终批准了新计划。

c: boast about one's wealth 夸耀财富
boast of 吹嘘
boast a library 以拥有图书馆而自豪
words.dif: boast 可作褒（以…自豪）可贬（吹嘘）；boast of/about 表吹嘘
words.pat: The city can justly boast of its old bookshops.
words.patZh: 这座城市有理由以其旧书店为傲。

words.exam: 奖金；红利；补贴；意外收获
c: an annual bonus 年终奖
a welcome bonus 意外收获
a housing bonus 住房补贴
fam: bonus payment 奖金支付 n. 相关延伸
words.dif: bonus 指「奖金、红利、额外好处」，可具体（年终奖）也可抽象（意外收获）
words.pat: A small bonus can lift the whole team's mood.
words.patZh: 一笔小小的奖金能提振整个团队的士气。

c: an economic boom 经济繁荣
a boom in sales 销量激增
business is booming 生意兴隆
words.dif: boom 名词/动词「繁荣、激增」，与 boost（推动）形近；boom 是结果，boost 是动作
words.pat: The port city enjoyed a boom after the new railway.
words.patZh: 新铁路开通后，这座港口城市迎来繁荣。

c: boost morale 提振士气
boost sales 提升销量
give a boost 助一臂之力
words.dif: boost 动词「提高、推动」，名词「帮助、增长」；与 boom（繁荣）形近需辨
words.pat: Better training can boost both skill and confidence.
words.patZh: 更好的培训能同时提升技能与信心。

words.exam: 用言辞的；口头的；动词的
c: a verbal agreement 口头协议
verbal skills 语言能力
a verbal noun 动名词
words.dif: verbal 指「口头的、言辞的」，也指「动词的」；oral 也表口头，二者近义
words.pat: A verbal promise is weaker than a written one.
words.patZh: 口头承诺比书面承诺弱。

c: reach a verdict 作出裁定
the verdict of history 历史的定论
a guilty verdict 有罪裁决
words.dif: verdict 原指「陪审团裁决」，引申「定论、意见」；与 verify（核实）形近
words.pat: The verdict of customers decided the firm's fate.
words.patZh: 顾客的裁决决定了公司的命运。

c: verify a claim 核实声明
verify the facts 核对事实
verify one's identity 核实身份
words.dif: verify 是及物「核实、证实」，verify facts/claims 是常见搭配
words.pat: Investors should verify every figure before deciding.
words.patZh: 投资者在决策前应核实每一个数字。

c: a verse from the poem 诗中的一节
free verse 自由诗
chapter and verse 确切出处
words.dif: verse 指「诗、诗句、诗节」，区别于 version（版本）与 verse 同源 versatile
words.pat: His witty line became a verse people quoted for weeks.
words.patZh: 他那机智的一行成了人们数周来反复引用的诗句。

words.exam: 版本；变化形式；译文；说法
c: the final version 最终版本
an English version 英文版
a new version 新说法
words.dif: version 除「版本」外常考「（个人视角的）说法」（his version of the event）；edition 仅指出版物版本
words.pat: The final version of the plan won wide support.
words.patZh: 计划的最终版本赢得了广泛支持。

c: a blood vessel 血管
a sailing vessel 帆船
a ceramic vessel 陶瓷容器
fam: vessel wall 血管壁 n. 相关延伸
words.dif: vessel 三义：船/舰、容器、血管（blood vessel），医学与航海都考
words.pat: The main vessel cracked and nearly sank the ship.
words.patZh: 主容器裂开，几乎让船沉没。
